children: SAID ON WEDNESDAY IT AGREED WITH STOCKHORN CAPITAL TO ENTER INTO SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE EXISTING CREDIT FACILITY AMEND IT FROM UP TO SEK 10 MILLION TO UP TO SEK 15 MILLION
SECOND AMENDMENT PROVIDES IRISITY WITH ADDITIONAL FINANCING AS THE COMPANY CONTINUES TO EXECUTE ITS STRATEGIC PLAN AND FINALISES ITS ONGOING SIMPLIFICATION AND EFFICIENCY MEASURES
SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE FACILITY FOLLOWS THE AMENDMENT ANNOUNCED ON 17 AUGUST 2026, WHEN THE MAXIMUM AMOUNT WAS INCREASED FROM UP TO SEK 5 MILLION TO UP TO SEK 10 MILLION
